`customers` is Tier1. Tier-1 assets change through review, so `add_tags` has been captured as a proposal rather than applied.

`fct_orders` is read directly by 3 assets and reaches 8 in total (1 chart, 3 dashboard, 2 dataset, 1 mlFeatureTable, 1 mlModel). Routing `update_description` to a human owner instead of applying it directly.
`fct_orders` is Tier1. Tier-1 assets change through review, so `update_description` has been captured as a proposal rather than applied.
`fct_orders` feeds production ML (mlFeatureTable at 1 hop, mlModel at 2 hops). Metadata changes here can silently invalidate features and deployed models, so `update_description` needs a human owner.
`dim_customers` is Tier1. Tier-1 assets change through review, so `remove_tags` has been captured as a proposal rather than applied.
`dim_customers` feeds production ML (mlFeatureTable at 2 hops, mlModel at 3 hops). Metadata changes here can silently invalidate features and deployed models, so `remove_tags` needs a human owner.
Note: `dim_customers` is read directly by 1 dashboard, 1 dataset. Changes here surface to business users.
`remove_tags` removes existing curated metadata from `dim_customers`. Removals are hard to notice after the fact, so this needs an owner's sign-off.
Refusing `update_description` on `support_tickets`: it is tagged [PII, Confidential], and changing the metadata of sensitive assets is reserved for its owners (nobody).
`support_tickets` has no owner, so no human would be notified if `update_description` were wrong. Held for triage.
`orders_snapshot_2023` has no owner, so no human would be notified if `set_domains` were wrong. Held for triage.
`orders_snapshot_2023` is marked deprecated in DataHub. Prefer its replacement before building anything new on it.

`urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:snowflake,analytics.marts.dim_customer,PROD)` does not exist in DataHub. Refusing `update_description` rather than creating metadata against an unverifiable asset - check the URN with `search` first.
